newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Labroy Marine says IPO 111 pct subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Labroy Marine says IPO 111 pct subscribed.

text.p: Marine logistics group Labroy Marine Ltd said on Wednesday shares available to the general public in its initial public offer (IPO) were 111 percent subscribed.
Labroy Marine said in a statement 36.4 million shares were available to the general public. The other 5.2 million shares in the public offer tranche were reserved shares.
Labroy Marine's IPO also included a placement tranche of 10.4 million shares.
All shares were priced at Singapore $0.69 each.
Trading in the shares is scheduled to start on October 18 on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
